High plunge exists in gcsim (highPlungeFrames: swap 61, hitmark 48) but not represented here; low plunge frames used per convention (swap 60, hitmark 46). Add _curatorNotes entry noting high plunge omission.

Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

abilities.name: Stellar Restoration
_curatorNotes: Base skillFrames E key (= 35f): gcsim explicitly sets skillFrames[ActionSkill] = 35. Keqing has no formal skill charges — E→recast is a conditional second cast; gcsim's ActionReady override routes ActionSkill to skillRecast() when stiletto status is active.

E Recast variant: cooldown (7.5s, cooldownStartDelay 20f) is set by the first cast (skillFirst) only and does not apply to the recast. Lightning Stiletto mark window is ~5.33s (5*60+20 = 320 frames per gcsim Status.Add). Reviewer to decide whether to model the stiletto mark as a summon on the base skill (label 'Lightning Stiletto', duration 5.33s, spawnsAt 25).
Hold variant (first cast): gcsim uses identical skillFrames for both tap and hold first cast — no separate hold frames authored. The hold only changes throw direction, not animation timing.
abilities.description:
Hurls a Lightning Stiletto that annihilates her opponents like the swift thunder.
When the Stiletto hits its target, it deals Electro DMG to opponents in a small AoE, and places a Stiletto Mark on the spot hit.

Hold
Hold to adjust the direction in which the Stiletto shall be thrown.
Stilettos thrown by the Hold attack mode can be suspended in mid-air, allowing Keqing to jump to them when using Stellar Restoration a second time.

Lightning Stiletto
 If Keqing uses Stellar Restoration again or uses a Charged Attack while its duration lasts, it will clear the Stiletto Mark and produce different effects:
·If she uses Stellar Restoration again, she will blink to the location of the Mark and unleash one slashing attack that deals AoE Electro DMG. When blinking to a Stiletto that was thrown from a Holding attack, Keqing can leap across obstructing terrain.
·If Keqing uses a Charged Attack, she will ignite a series of thundering cuts at the Mark's location, dealing AoE Electro DMG.

abilities.name: Starward Sword
abilities.description:
Keqing unleashes the power of lightning, dealing Electro DMG in an AOE.
She then blends into the shadow of her blade, striking a series of thunderclap-blows to nearby opponents simultaneously that deal multiple instances of Electro DMG. The final attack deals massive AoE Electro DMG.

constellations.name: Thundering Might
_curatorNotes: Existing damage effect: inherited `manual` trigger. Likely `onCast` with skill recast condition; gcsim fires 2 hits in skillRecast() — one at frame 3 (start point, CircleHitOnTarget at caster) and one at frame 16/skillRecastHitmark (terminus, CircleHit toward target). Multiplier 0.5 = 50% ATK confirmed from gcsim Mult field. Reviewer to decide trigger representation for the dual hit positions.
constellations.description: Recasting Stellar Restoration while a Lightning Stiletto is present causes Keqing to deal 50% of her ATK as AoE Electro DMG at the start point and terminus of her Blink.

constellations.name: Keen Extraction
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored. C2: Normal and Charged Attacks hitting Electro-affected enemies have 50% chance to produce 1 Electro Elemental Particle (5s ICD per gcsim c2ICDKey status). Implemented in cons.go makeC2CB(). Likely `onHit` with Electro-aura condition; target scope: self (energy for self).

This effect can only occur once every 5s.

constellations.name: Attunement
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored. C4: ATK +25% for 10s after Keqing triggers an Electro reaction. Likely `onReaction`. Reaction types from gcsim cons.go c4(): Overload, ElectroCharged, LunarCharged, Superconduct, SwirlElectro, CrystallizeElectro, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom. Reaction list needs KQM verification — game text uses vague phrasing. Target scope: self. Multiplier 0.25 = 25% ATK confirmed from gcsim c4buff[attributes.ATKP] = 0.25.

constellations.name: Tenacious Star
_curatorNotes: Existing electroDmgBonus effect: inherited `manual` trigger. Fires on cast of N, CA, E, or Q — gcsim calls c6() from attack.go, charge.go, skill.go, and burst.go respectively. Effects from different ability types are independent entities (up to 4 concurrent stacks, each with own 8s timer per gcsim modifier key 'keqing-c6-'+src). Reviewer to decide stack modeling — consider `stacks: { maxStacks: 4, durationModel: "separate" }`.
constellations.description:
When initiating a Normal Attack, a Charged Attack, Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, Keqing gains a 6% Electro DMG Bonus for 8s.
Effects triggered by Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts are considered independent entities.
